message: docs: reconcile delivered narration and conversation work with remaining acceptance

replacements.old: New speech now uses durable conversation identity; missing legacy association is explicit.
replacements.new: New speech uses durable conversation identity; genuinely unknown association within supported records stays explicit. This SQLite observation is historical, not a requirement to restore that removed backend or import incompatible saves.

replacements.old: Finalize response/target/source types, expression boundaries, configurable limits, conversation/awareness invariants and source-order rules.
replacements.new: The current response, expression, conversation and source contracts exist. Reconcile remaining target/audience cases and verify configurable limits, awareness invariants and source ordering through the existing owners.

replacements.old: Implement independently receipted talk/act/think, private `self_thought` memories, self-awareness and later consolidation/retrieval; preserve existing reflection contracts.
replacements.new: Qualify the delivered independently receipted `operations[]`, private `self_thought` memories, self-awareness and later consolidation/retrieval; preserve existing reflection contracts rather than rebuilding the earlier one-slot talk/act/think shape.

replacements.old: Admit bounded effect-free expressions; route known mechanics normally; expose actual effect/condition receipts and causation.
replacements.new: Seven trusted effect-free expression families and ordinary native action routing are delivered. Complete the remaining expression/privacy cases and qualify actual effect/condition receipts and causation without treating arbitrary expressive prose as a mechanical capability.

replacements.old: Extend external event catalogue, event-time awareness, configured importance scoring and zero-witness retention.
replacements.new: The shared external-event path, event-time awareness, bounded importance scoring and trusted notable zero-witness retention are delivered. Extend only supported missing event families and qualify their consistent retention/disclosure behavior.

replacements.old: Add conversations, membership intervals, transition receipts, per-speech association, self-talk and native close/leave policies.
replacements.new: Conversations, membership intervals, transition receipts, per-speech association, self-talk and native close/leave policies are delivered in `conversations.ts`. Qualify remaining multi-party lifecycle/audience scenarios; local reconnect grace and multiplayer participation are distinct policies, not missing duplicate conversation stores.

replacements.old: Implement source closure/redirect, whole-current-group transfer, destination bridging speech and terminal narration notices.
replacements.new: Source closure/redirect, whole-current-group transfer, destination bridging speech and terminal narration notices are delivered. Qualify concurrent/opposing merges and late reply admission through that single mutation owner.

replacements.old: Add PostgreSQL story rows, typed source joins, impact projections, owner checks, indexes, idempotent publication and profile voice settings.
replacements.new: PostgreSQL story records/source joins, impact projections, owner checks, indexed queries, idempotent publication and profile voice settings are delivered through `history.ts` and the existing store. Qualify the remaining provenance/recovery matrix; the canonical target schema names do not require creating a parallel store.

replacements.old: Parameterize permitted source assembly/retrieval, modes, mandatory evidence and bounded generation; validate grounded output and display “Narration failed.” on failure, without substituted prose or automatic retry.
replacements.new: Scoped source assembly, mandatory evidence, bounded grounded generation and exact “Narration failed.” presentation are delivered without substituted prose or automatic retry. Qualify remaining grounding, voice and failure cases. Private-thought/cutaway modes remain disabled until their explicit disclosure contract and acceptance are delivered.

replacements.old: Add outbox triggers, first-visit/encounter dedup, causal coalescing, meteor fan-out, saved timeline anchors and cancellation/recovery rules.
replacements.new: Durable triggers, supported first-encounter deduplication, causal coalescing, principal-scoped fan-out, saved timeline anchors and cancellation/recovery are delivered. Qualify remaining multi-viewer ordering and deduplication cases. Place entities and inventory encounters still need a supported exposure contract; do not claim those are implemented or add a second event bus.

replacements.old: Merge viewer-authorized event/narration records, suppress duplicate action rendering, show smaller actual impacts, top-screen story and private Journal; add voice controls and accessible motion/focus handling.
replacements.new: Viewer-authorized transcript/Journal paging, action deduplication, actual-impact display, story banners and voice controls are delivered. Complete remaining combined browser/accessibility and scope-revocation qualification through these surfaces, not another transcript implementation.

replacements.old: mark gaps, pin/expire sources honestly, propagate revocations/corrections, define adapter capabilities and verify backup/restore.
replacements.new: mark gaps, preserve source capsules and propagated revocations/corrections, and qualify current PostgreSQL backup/restore. Transactional revocation is delivered; automatic historical expiry remains disabled until retention/pinning semantics and evidence are complete.

replacements.new: multiple NPCs, explicitly unknown supported-record association, later turns within the captured snapshot and semantic outage. Do not add an old-format reader or revive SQLite for these checks.

replacements.old: Proposed disconnect behavior: retain membership through a bounded real-time reconnect grace, then leave; NPC departure uses a configured simulation-time inactivity/proximity policy.
replacements.new: Current local-mode disconnect handling retains membership through a bounded real-time reconnect grace, then leaves through the same conversation transition; authenticated multiplayer absence uses its participation owner instead. NPC departure uses the configured simulation-time inactivity/proximity policy.

replacements.old: Reuse existing planned `mind.conversations` and event-awareness families rather than create competing stores. Names below describe target storage, not a claim that these exact tables are deployed.
replacements.new: Conversation lifecycle currently persists with the authoritative world; `history.ts` owns PostgreSQL `history_events`, `story_narrations`, event/transition source joins, jobs, milestones and delivery records, while the existing profile owns voice preferences. Reuse these owners and the event-awareness family rather than create competing stores. Names below describe the broader production target storage, not a claim that these exact names or every proposed index are deployed. Any later extraction replaces its current owner atomically; it does not create a second writable conversation or transcript.

replacements.new: Current generated response: bounded `sentences`

replacements.old: Before implementation, tune finite response/text limits, event-importance weights/thresholds, narrator batching window, disconnect/inactivity grace, historical story retention and initial voice choices. First slice defaults: one optional component of each kind, one active conversation per actor, actor-scoped private prose, cutaways disabled until disclosure policy is configured, and no new mechanical invention. Exact values belong to admitted configuration with documented acceptance evidence.
replacements.new: Current response/text bounds, importance scoring, narrator batching, disconnect/inactivity grace and voice choices are documented in the [limits inventory](limits/narration.md); tune changes against their actual workload and evidence. Responses use AG01’s bounded optional `operations[]`, including repeated supported kinds and an empty response, not one slot per kind. One active conversation per actor and actor-scoped private prose remain the initial policy. Cutaways and automatic historical expiry remain disabled pending their disclosure/retention contracts; narration introduces no mechanical invention. Exact values belong to their admitted owners, with implementation and remaining acceptance distinguished.

replacements.old: ### CR12 — Acceptance and token/latency evidence
replacements.new:
### CR12 — Acceptance and token/latency evidence

- [ ] **Refresh current installed-activity fixture expectations without weakening coverage.** Existing CI run [37133569246](https://github.com/Macrofold/OpenLegend/actions/runs/37133569246) on 2026-10-03 passed guidance, generated configuration, formatting and TypeScript, then reported 328 passing and eight failing tests on runtime source `b528af6`. Seven `cognition-payloads.test.ts` cases reject the delivered “Optional installed activity requests” section through `KNOWN_HEADINGS`; one `cognition-verification.test.ts` case omits its `request_1` route criterion. Update those exact expectations against the current world-owned activity request contract, preserve strict section completeness and bounded permitted criteria, and rerun the two focused existing files. Do not remove the installed feature, allow arbitrary headings/criteria or claim the remaining assertions passed: the first failures prevent later assertions from running. Production build was not reached in that CI chain; no live-provider acceptance follows. This is one fixture-contract repair, not eight new gameplay defects or proof that broader CR12 is complete.
